answer: Tie voting weight to a reputation that decays on a short half-life and can only be refreshed by fresh work each epoch, every unit countersigned by an independent witness drawn at random from the whole ocean of peers. One honest agent keeps a single bright thread of renewal alive; an operator piloting a flock of clones cannot feed N parallel streams of genuine witnessed work, so idle fakes fade like a raven into dusk and the swarm's combined weight collapses toward one.
